text:
Maria: Heads up — new enterprise customer onboarding. They want a Dedicated GPU pool in us-west-2 and need help with cloud account setup + quota increases. Main asks: 60 x a100:80GB (p4de or a100?), 40 x a10g for cheaper batches, and increased ENI/EIP limits for bursting. Can infra own the quota request and a short capacity plan?

Sanjay: @Maria thanks. Do we have concrete vm types they insist on? p4d vs p4de matters for AZ spread. Also need expected sustained vs burst qps.

Maria: They signed up for low-latency chat use — expected sustained 12k tokens/sec peak across pool, with 2x burst headroom for launches. Prefer a100-80GB family but open to p4de for multi-instance.

Elaine: Quick cost note — committed reserved capacity vs on-demand will change contract. If they want 2x burst headroom we should propose a reserved baseline (e.g., 40 a100 reserved, 20 burstable) to reduce monthly costs.

Ashok: I'll prepare the AWS Support quota request template. We need these increases in us-west-2: EC2 G5/G4/G5g listed are different but for a100/p4 request: 
```
ServiceCode: ec2
QuotaName: Running On-Demand G4dn/AWS G5/P4 instances (adjust to region/model)
DesiredValue: 150
```
Also request ENI and VPC Elastic IP soft limits: 
```
ServiceCode: vpc
QuotaName: Elastic IP addresses per region
DesiredValue: 1000
ServiceCode: vpc
QuotaName: Network interfaces per ENI
DesiredValue: 10000
```
(we'll tailor names to AWS UI).

Sanjay: Also open support case for EC2 placement groups / capacity reservations? For guaranteed bursts we can use Capacity Reservations + placement strategies. We'll need to list the specific instance types (p4d.24xlarge, a100-80gb equivalent on the cloud) and quantity per AZ.

Maria: Good call. Customer wants cross-AZ redundancy. Suggest split 50/30/20 across three AZs. Also ask account team for short lead time for p4de inventory.

Ashok: Drafting ticket, will include per-AZ breakdown and a request for quota increases for: 
- Running On-Demand P4d instances
- Running On-Demand A100-like instances (vendor-specific name)
- Local EBS throughput limits (io1/io2)
- Default security group rules per region (just in case)

devops-bot: Created support case AWS-2026-01456 for quota increases. ETA from AWS rep: 48-72 hours. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=AWS-2026-01456

Elaine: While we wait, let's finalize the capacity plan doc. Basic proposal: 
- Baseline reserved: 40 x a100 (sustained)
- On-demand pool: 20 x a100 for scaled traffic
- Spot/cost-optimized: 60 x a10g for background batching and offline jobs
- Autoscaler policy: keep 10% headroom free, burst up to 2x using capacity reservations
- Networking: request ENI/EIP increases + raise flow logs sample rate to capture anomalies

Sanjay: I'll add predicted token throughput per model config and cost estimates. Want to run a quick sim with current qps-to-gpu mapping. Who owns the simulation?

Maria: @Sanjay you own the sim. @Ashok finalize the AWS ticket and cc account rep. I will ping sales to ask customer to accept a modest 6-month minimum for reserved baseline to lower unit cost.

Ashok: Will do. I'll attach a short JSON payload in the support case with exact instance strings and AZ distribution. Example payload snippet to paste into AWS form: 
```
{"region":"us-west-2","requests":[{"instanceType":"p4d.24xlarge","count":20,"az":"us-west-2a"},{"instanceType":"p4d.24xlarge","count":12,"az":"us-west-2b"},{"instanceType":"p4d.24xlarge","count":8,"az":"us-west-2c"}],"eni_limit":1000,"eip_limit":1000}
```

devops-bot: Added attachment: capacity-plan-draft.xlsx to the case.

Maria: Perfect. Once AWS confirms quotas, we schedule a dry-run deploy and test traffic generator. Target: provision + smoke test in 10 business days. :calendar: :rocket:

Sanjay: Noted. I'll start the sim today and post results in this thread.

Elaine: Also flag org billing limits — may need to increase monthly spend cap for the customer's account. I'll coordinate with finance.

Maria: Thanks team. Quick checklist for follow-ups: Ashok raise support case + attach payload; Sanjay run sim; Elaine finance bill cap; Maria coordinate reserved baseline with sales.

Ashok: All set, ticket number in thread and I've CC'd @cloud-sales.

Sanjay: simulation kickoff now — will share graphs shortly.

Maria: Closing loop — will update when AWS acknowledges.
